text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up from Leo in CS — VeloxPay reporting a new spike in embeddings p99 on hosted, customer-facing incidents page shows degraded latency around 18:02 UTC.

Leo Ramos (CS): Their traffic pattern changed (larger batch of long docs). Experiencing ~3s p99 vs usual ~600ms. They're asking for immediate mitigation and ETA.

Maya Singh (oncall): I'm on it, can someone confirm whether dedicated pool routing or fallback to smaller model is enabled for that customer?

Priya Nair: Routing policy is default; no auto-fallback to smaller model for tenants on hosted unless we trigger it. We can flip a manual routing override.

Jonah Park: Saw a similar blip earlier during the 02:xx window — autoscaler didn't spin extra pods because warm pool had been drained. Suspect a burst of long-seq requests hitting kv-cache misses. log excerpt: ```WARN kvcache: miss seq_len=4096 latency=0.98s```

Alex Chen: Can we do (1) temporary routing to a cheaper, lower-latency embedding model, or (2) enable prefix caching for VeloxPay while we triage? Which is less risky for quality?

Priya Nair: (1) is fast — toggle routing -> smaller-embed-v2 takes <5m. Quality delta is negligible for their use case (semantic search). (2) needs infra change, ~20-30m plus verification.

Maya Singh (oncall): I can flip routing now if someone approves. We should also file a follow-up to restore routing after capacity scales.

Jonah Park: Agree with routing flip. I'll scope a short-term autoscale tweak: bump warm pool target + pin one extra instance to avoid cold starts for next 2 hours. ETA ~15m to push.

Leo Ramos (CS): VeloxPay will accept the routing switch for now, but wants firm timeline for permanent fix. Can eng commit to post-mortem and follow-up patch?

Alex Chen: Yes — commit: triage + hotfix plan in next 4 hours, post-mortem and customer-facing note within 24h. Owners: Jonah (runtime), Priya (routing/rollout), Maya (oncall triage), Alex (customer comms).

deploy-bot: deploy queued by Jonah -> canary: warm-pool-bump v2 -> status: pending checks

Priya Nair: I'll make the routing change once Jonah confirms canary is green. Leaving a /cc to eng-platform infra for capacity ops if canary fails.

Jonah Park: Canary passed basic checks, pushing now. I'll monitor p95/p99, KV cache hit rate, and CPU/GPU utilization.

Maya Singh (oncall): Monitoring: p99 dropped to ~750ms after routing flip. VeloxPay confirmed improved UX. Keeping this thread open for 2h monitoring and then we'll close with action items.

Alex Chen: Thanks team. Action items summary in thread — Jonah to roll warm-pool patch + verify, Priya to flip routing and document change, Maya to monitor and escalate if regression, Alex to draft customer note. We'll sync on any blocker updates here. :thumbsup:

Leo Ramos (CS): I'll let the customer know and request a follow-up call later today. Thanks all.

Maya Singh (oncall): Noting follow-up ticket: INT-45321 -> owners Jonah, Priya. Will create PM with timeline for permanent autoscale adjustments.

Jonah Park: Logging next steps in runtime repo PR and tagging eng-platform reviewers. ETA full fix (autoscale + cache work) 3-5 days depending on Q/A.

Alex Chen: Good. Closing loop: temporary mitigation done, monitoring in progress, formal remediation tracked. If anyone sees new spikes, ping @here.
